name: vipin
beta_app_description: vipin is an open-source client for user-provided network servers and subscriptions. It supports VLESS and VK TURN connections, configurable routing, and local connection diagnostics. The developer does not sell VPN subscriptions or operate a VPN service. Users supply their own server configuration.
what_to_test: Test subscription import and refresh, VLESS and VK TURN connections, routing changes, reconnecting after network changes, and stopping the tunnel. Check the privacy policy, software licenses, and release source information available before import and in Profile. Please include the app version, iOS version, and reproduction steps in feedback; remove subscription links, tokens, and other secrets from logs before sending them.
review_notes: vipin is a client for user-provided servers and subscriptions. It does not sell VPN access or provide developer-operated VPN connectivity. The Connection tab starts and stops the tunnel, Routing controls routing rules, and Profile contains settings, local logs, the privacy policy, licenses, and source information. Before the first connection, the app explains its data handling. VK TURN mode uses VK API and TURN relay infrastructure as an intermediate transport to a user-configured exit server. A demonstration subscription is supplied separately in the private review notes. Its VPN server entries are placeholders: subscription import, refresh, and the configured interface can be inspected, but these entries do not provide a working VPN connection. The optional self-hosted subscription server is available at https://github.com/acurofobia/subscription-ui-server. It serves configuration and interface documents; it does not create or host a VPN exit server. End-to-end connectivity testing requires real server parameters supplied by the tester. The application source is available at https://github.com/acurofobia/sing-box-for-apple.
